title_sq: Prane Tregut Elektrik ,Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Verande Dhe Pamje Fantastike!!!
description_sq: Prane Tregut Elektrik, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Verande Fantastike!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste te nje ndertimi te ri me punime mjaft cilesore ku vihet re fasasda e jashtme me termoizolim dhe izolim akustik(sistem kapot), fasadat dopio xham-termike me material pvc, hidrosanitare dhe instalime incaso,instalime kondicionimi multisplit, lartesi kati 290 cm, linje trefazori, sistem antizjarr etj, aktualisht ne faze rifiniturash i cili behet i banueshm shume shpejt. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 177.2 m2 prej te cilave 87.5 m2 siperfaqe neto, 20.9 m2 siperfaqe ndihmese dhe 68.8 m2 siperfaqe verande dhe organizohet ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete ku ai i dhomes matrimoniale me dritare, veranda fantastike ku kane dalje te gjitha ambientet e apartamentit. Orientimi i apartamentit drejt Jug Perendimit dhe Veri Perendimit e ben te kete diell dhe drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ofron te gjitha facilitetet e mundshme per nje jetese sa me komode.
title_en: Near the Electric Market, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with Veranda and Fantastic View!!!
description_en: Near the Electric Market, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with Fantastic Verandah!!! The apartment is located on the fifth floor of a new building with very high-quality work, where you can see the external facade with thermal insulation and acoustic insulation (kapot system), double-glazed facades with PVC material, hydrosanitary and incaso installations, multisplit air conditioning installations, floor height 290 cm, three-phase line, fire protection system, etc., currently in the refinishing phase, which will be habitable very soon. The apartment has a total area of ​​177.2 m2, of which 87.5 m2 is a net area, 20.9 m2 is an auxiliary area and 68.8 m2 is a veranda area and is organized in the living room together with the kitchen area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms where the one in the matrimonial room has a window, a fantastic veranda where all the premises of the apartment have exits. The orientation of the apartment towards South West and North West makes it sun and natural light throughout the day. The area in which it is located offers all possible facilities for a comfortable life.
